suggested_requirements.text: The system shall analyze incoming instructions and categorize them.
The system shall match buy and sell instructions based on specific prescripts.
The system shall provide interfaces to send messages to other subsystems.
The system shall receive instructions from the trade client serve.
The system shall produce new messages for the network message promulgating subsystem after processing instructions.
The system shall allow the system manager to access information within the CTS.
The system shall save buy instructions.
The system shall match buy instructions with the same stock ID.
The system shall execute trades by matching instructions.
The system shall modify the information of matched instructions.
The system shall save sell instructions.
The system shall match sell instructions with the same stock ID.
The system shall save cancel instructions.
The system shall cancel the correlative instruction upon receiving a cancel instruction.
The system shall output successful trade information to the security account management subsystem.
The system shall implement queries from the trading information release system.
The system shall structuralize queried data for the release system.
The system shall send queried data to the release system.
The system shall validate incoming instructions in the pretreatment module.
The system shall freeze funds in the user's account based on trade instructions.
The system shall write log files for processed instructions.
The system shall reject trading instructions if the price exceeds rising or falling limits.
The system shall return the result of trading instructions to the client serve.
The system shall remove instructions from the CTS if they are not finished within one day.
The system shall provide terminal users with simplified operations confined to mouse clicks and keyboard inputs.
The system shall handle high frequency operations including fetching, dealing, and repealing instructions.
The system shall implement strategies to overcome system crashes when overhead exceeds capacity.
The system shall authorize the system manager to access information.
